shortDescriptions.value: He loves two things: his train and his girl.

longDescriptions.value: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern train engineer chases it deep behind enemy lines in one of the great chase comedies.

shortDescriptions.value: A projectionist dreams his way into the movies.

longDescriptions.value: A small-town projectionist who dreams of being a detective falls asleep on the job and walks straight into the movie on screen.

shortDescriptions.value: One man. Twelve stories. No net.

longDescriptions.value: A small-town go-getter promises his sweetheart he has made it big in the city, then has to climb the outside of a skyscraper to prove it.

shortDescriptions.value: The most popular man on campus — in his own mind.

longDescriptions.value: An eager college newcomer tries to become the most popular man on campus and ends up the tackling dummy of the football team.

shortDescriptions.value: Newlyweds. A build-it-yourself house. What could go wrong?

longDescriptions.value: Newlyweds try to assemble a build-it-yourself house in seven days, not knowing a jealous rival has swapped the numbers on the boxes.

shortDescriptions.value: The fastest-talking newsroom ever filmed.

longDescriptions.value: A fast-talking newspaper editor schemes to stop his star reporter, who is also his ex-wife, from quitting and remarrying by handing her one last big story.

shortDescriptions.value: The original vampire. Still the scariest.

longDescriptions.value: A real-estate clerk travels to the Carpathians to close a sale with the reclusive Count, who then follows him home bringing plague and death.

shortDescriptions.value: Beneath the opera house, someone is listening.

longDescriptions.value: A disfigured genius haunting the cellars beneath the Paris Opera grooms a young singer for stardom, and will kill anyone who stands in his way.

shortDescriptions.value: They won't stay dead.

longDescriptions.value: Strangers barricade themselves inside a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in through the night.

shortDescriptions.value: Feed me.

longDescriptions.value: A hapless florist's assistant breeds a strange plant that makes the shop famous, but it only thrives on human blood.

shortDescriptions.value: She walked away from the crash. Or did she?

longDescriptions.value: After surviving a car crash into a river, a church organist starts a new life in Utah but is stalked by a ghoulish figure and drawn to an abandoned pavilion.

shortDescriptions.value: The city of the future was built in 1927.

longDescriptions.value: In a towering future city split between idle rulers and underground workers, the ruler's son falls for a prophet of the workers, and an inventor builds a robot in her image.

shortDescriptions.value: The first science-fiction film ever made.

longDescriptions.value: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the moon in a giant shell, lands in the Man in the Moon's eye, and escapes the moon's strange inhabitants.

titles.value: All Quiet on the Western Front

shortDescriptions.value: Young men, sold a glorious war.

longDescriptions.value: A class of German schoolboys enlists in the First World War full of patriotic fire and learns in the trenches what the war really costs.

shortDescriptions.value: A man reports his own murder.

longDescriptions.value: A small-town accountant learns he has been fatally poisoned and has only days left to find out who killed him, and why.

shortDescriptions.value: One day in the life of a city, told only in pictures.

longDescriptions.value: A cameraman roams Soviet cities from dawn to dusk in a wordless, restlessly inventive portrait of modern life and of filmmaking itself.

shortDescriptions.value: A gentle giant. Three very rude rodents.

longDescriptions.value: A gentle giant rabbit's sunny day is ruined by three bullying rodents, so he plans an elaborate cartoon revenge.

shortDescriptions.value: A girl, a dragon, and a search across the world.

longDescriptions.value: A lone young woman crosses a harsh fantasy world to find the baby dragon she rescued and raised, which was snatched away from her.

shortDescriptions.value: Amsterdam, the future, and a robot problem.

longDescriptions.value: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a band of scientists stages a desperate experiment to rewrite a painful breakup that set the machines loose.

shortDescriptions.value: Two men inside a machine that makes no sense.

longDescriptions.value: Two men wander an endless, shifting machine world, the older one insisting he knows its rules while the younger begins to doubt him.

shortDescriptions.value: A suicidal sheep gets a second chance. And a third.

longDescriptions.value: On a desolate island, a despairing sheep named Franck meets a strange salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime, with a catch.

shortDescriptions.value: A shepherd girl and her dog face the spirits of winter.

longDescriptions.value: A shepherd girl and her dog face the ancient mountain spirits in order to keep the cycle of life turning.

shortDescriptions.value: Teenagers in the woods. Tiny, angry forest sprites.

longDescriptions.value: A group of rowdy teens on a woodland outing tangle with an eccentric nature lover and the adorable-looking mushroom sprites that guard the forest.

shortDescriptions.value: One shot. Four minutes. No rules.

longDescriptions.value: In an energy-starved dystopia, an old man breaks into a battery factory and finds himself trapped with a deadly security droid.

shortDescriptions.value: A feud, a family dinner, and a very long waterfall.

longDescriptions.value: A young man travels South to claim his inheritance and falls for a girl whose family has sworn a blood feud against his, and they cannot shoot him while he is a guest in their house.

shortDescriptions.value: Marry by 7 p.m. or lose seven million dollars.

longDescriptions.value: A broke young stockbroker learns he will inherit seven million dollars if he is married by 7 p.m. that day, and his one newspaper ad brings a stampede of would-be brides.

shortDescriptions.value: One cyclone. One falling house front. One Buster.

longDescriptions.value: A college dandy returns home to his gruff riverboat-captain father, falls for the daughter of Dad's rival, and ends up riding out a cyclone in one of the most famous stunts ever filmed.

shortDescriptions.value: Two millionaires. One empty ocean liner.

longDescriptions.value: A spoiled millionaire and the heiress who turned him down end up alone, adrift on an enormous empty ocean liner.

shortDescriptions.value: The bookworm goes out for every sport.

longDescriptions.value: A bookish high-school valedictorian who scorns sports goes to college and tries every athletic event on campus to win the girl.

shortDescriptions.value: He bought a newsreel camera to get the girl.

longDescriptions.value: A tintype photographer buys a battered newsreel camera to impress a girl at MGM's newsreel office, and a runaway monkey helps him land the scoop of his life.

shortDescriptions.value: New York's fastest soda jerk. And its last horse car.

longDescriptions.value: A baseball-mad New York soda jerk fights to save his girlfriend's grandfather's horse-drawn streetcar, the last in the city, with a cameo from Babe Ruth.

shortDescriptions.value: Hooray for Captain Spaulding.

longDescriptions.value: Captain Spaulding, the famous African explorer, crashes a Long Island society party where a priceless painting goes missing, with all four Marx Brothers at full throttle.

shortDescriptions.value: She's got It.

longDescriptions.value: A spirited department-store salesgirl with plenty of 'It' sets her sights on the store's handsome young owner.

shortDescriptions.value: A song of two humans.

longDescriptions.value: A farmer tempted by a woman from the city plots to drown his wife, then spends a long, redemptive day in the city falling in love with her again.

shortDescriptions.value: Sanctuary.

longDescriptions.value: In 15th-century Paris, the deformed bell-ringer Quasimodo risks everything to protect the Gypsy dancer Esmeralda from a scheming nobleman and a mob.

shortDescriptions.value: One man. Two souls.

longDescriptions.value: A saintly London doctor tests a potion that splits off his darker self, and the monstrous Mr. Hyde begins to take over.

shortDescriptions.value: The dead walk the sugar mill.

longDescriptions.value: A young couple's wedding trip to Haiti turns to horror when a jealous planter enlists a voodoo master who commands an army of the walking dead.

shortDescriptions.value: The castle remembers.

longDescriptions.value: A lost French officer follows a mysterious woman to the castle of a haunted baron, where a vengeful witch is waiting.

shortDescriptions.value: The family has a secret at the bottom of the pond.

longDescriptions.value: A scheming widow hides her husband's death from his wealthy Irish family, just as an axe murderer starts stalking their castle.

shortDescriptions.value: Is she a mermaid, or something worse?

longDescriptions.value: A lonely sailor on shore leave falls for a sideshow 'mermaid' who may be descended from sea creatures that kill by the full moon.

shortDescriptions.value: A killer in the mansion. A fortune in the walls.

longDescriptions.value: A mystery writer rents a country mansion where a fortune is hidden in the walls, and a masked killer called The Bat wants it back.

shortDescriptions.value: The quiet new professor has a past.

longDescriptions.value: A war-crimes investigator tracks a Nazi fugitive to a sleepy Connecticut town, where he is posing as a respected teacher about to marry the judge's daughter.

shortDescriptions.value: He painted her. She ruined him.

longDescriptions.value: A meek cashier and Sunday painter falls for a con woman who, with her brutal boyfriend, schemes to sell his paintings as her own.

shortDescriptions.value: Four masked men. One framed driver.

longDescriptions.value: A delivery driver framed for an armored-car robbery tracks the masked gang to a Mexican resort to clear his name.

shortDescriptions.value: Don't pick him up.

longDescriptions.value: Two friends on a fishing trip pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a psychopathic killer, and he forces them to drive him across the Mexican desert.

shortDescriptions.value: Three gunmen. One small town. One window.

longDescriptions.value: Three hired gunmen take over a family's hilltop house in a small town to ambush the President's train, with Frank Sinatra as their cold-blooded leader.

shortDescriptions.value: Cop versus mob, in the dark.

longDescriptions.value: An obsessed police lieutenant goes after a sadistic mob boss, and the key may be the gangster's unhappy girlfriend.

shortDescriptions.value: Hitchcock's first talkie.

longDescriptions.value: A Scotland Yard detective's girlfriend kills an artist in self-defense, and a blackmailer who saw her starts squeezing the couple. It was Hitchcock's first talkie.

shortDescriptions.value: Holmes, Watson and a hypnotist.

longDescriptions.value: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a string of murders of young women in London, and the trail leads to hypnotism and Professor Moriarty.

shortDescriptions.value: The Oregon Trail, in John Wayne's first starring role.

longDescriptions.value: A young trapper guides a wagon train of pioneers along the Oregon Trail while hunting the men who murdered his friend. This was John Wayne's first starring role.

shortDescriptions.value: A gunslinger meets a Quaker girl.

longDescriptions.value: A wounded gunslinger is nursed back to health by a Quaker family, and their daughter's faith starts to pull him away from his outlaw past.

shortDescriptions.value: Bleeding Kansas, on the eve of war.

longDescriptions.value: West Point graduates Jeb Stuart and George Custer are posted to Bleeding Kansas and clash with abolitionist John Brown in the years before the Civil War.

shortDescriptions.value: The fop by day. The fox by night.

longDescriptions.value: In Spanish California, a foppish young nobleman secretly rides as the masked swordsman Zorro to defend the people against a corrupt governor.

shortDescriptions.value: The original swashbuckler.

longDescriptions.value: The Earl of Huntingdon returns from the Crusades to find Prince John terrorizing England, and becomes the outlaw Robin Hood to fight back.

shortDescriptions.value: Happiness must be earned.

longDescriptions.value: A cocky Baghdad thief falls for the Caliph's daughter and sets out on a quest through monsters, magic and a flying carpet to win her.

shortDescriptions.value: One man versus the pirate crew.

longDescriptions.value: To avenge his father, a young nobleman joins the pirate crew that killed him, and must rescue a captive princess before the pirates claim her.

shortDescriptions.value: Dinosaurs in London, 1925.

longDescriptions.value: Professor Challenger leads an expedition to a remote South American plateau where dinosaurs still roam, and brings a brontosaurus back to London.

shortDescriptions.value: The first Best Picture. Still soaring.

longDescriptions.value: Two small-town rivals for the same girl become fighter pilots and best friends in the skies over WWI France. It won the first Academy Award for Best Picture.

shortDescriptions.value: Howard Hughes's war in the air.

longDescriptions.value: Two very different English brothers join the Royal Flying Corps in WWI and are torn apart by war and by the same woman, with some of the most spectacular aerial combat ever filmed.

shortDescriptions.value: He marched off to war a boy.

longDescriptions.value: A pampered rich boy enlists after America enters WWI, finds comradeship and love in rural France, and then faces the horror of the front.

shortDescriptions.value: The man who never existed became a movement.

longDescriptions.value: A fired columnist invents a letter from a 'John Doe' threatening suicide in protest, then hires a drifter to play him, and a national movement spins out of control.

shortDescriptions.value: The original.

longDescriptions.value: A farm girl with dreams of Hollywood becomes a star with the help of a matinee idol, even as his own career and his drinking drag him down.

shortDescriptions.value: One man among millions.

longDescriptions.value: An ambitious young man arrives in New York sure he'll be somebody, then struggles through marriage, loss and a job as one more clerk in the crowd.

shortDescriptions.value: A storm, a quarantine and a sinner.

longDescriptions.value: Stranded by quarantine on a South Seas island, a defiant prostitute clashes with a fanatical missionary who is determined to reform her.
